verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an API-first payments platform: it exposes a documented REST API with long-lived API keys for server-to-server calls, an OpenAPI spec, and a full sandbox test environment, all of which support scripted/headless automation (e.g., in CI pipelines) rather than requiring a UI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, test-runner integration, or automation-pipeline guidance in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or automated testing pipeline documentation, evidence of headless/batch execution modes, and independent confirmation of API-only automated workflows.
